verses.original: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ lə·haz·kîr Yah·weh ’al- ṯō·w·ḵî·ḥê·nî bə·qeṣ·pə·ḵā ṯə·yas·sə·rê·nî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: A Psalm of David for remembrance O LORD do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י יָדֶֽךָ׃ וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā ni·ḥă·ṯū ḇî yā·ḏe·ḵā wat·tin·ḥaṯ ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply and Your hand has pressed down on me

verses.original: אֵין־ מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־ שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- mə·ṯōm biḇ·śā·rî mip·pə·nê za‘·me·ḵā ’ên- šā·lō·wm ba·‘ă·ṣā·may mip·pə·nê ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger there is no rest in my bones because of my sin

verses.original: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯay ‘ā·ḇə·rū rō·šî kə·maś·śā ḵā·ḇêḏ yiḵ·bə·ḏū mim·men·nî
verses.literal: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me they are a burden too heavy to bear . . .

verses.original: חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥab·bū·rō·ṯāy hiḇ·’î·šū nā·maq·qū mip·pə·nê ’iw·wal·tî
verses.literal: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly

verses.original: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃ קֹדֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: na·‘ă·wê·ṯî ša·ḥō·ṯî ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ kāl- hay·yō·wm hil·lā·ḵə·tî qō·ḏêr
verses.literal: I am bent and brought low . . . . . . all day long . . . I go about mourning

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵə·sā·lay mā·lə·’ū niq·leh wə·’ên mə·ṯōm biḇ·śā·rî
verses.literal: For my loins are full of burning pain and no soundness [remains] in my body

verses.original: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: nə·p̄ū·ḡō·w·ṯî ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ wə·niḏ·kê·ṯî šā·ʾag̲·tî min·na·hă·maṯ lib·bî
verses.literal: I am numb and badly . . . crushed I groan in anguish of heart

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽדֹנָי כָל־ תַּאֲוָתִ֑י נֶגְדְּךָ֥ וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י לֹא־ נִסְתָּֽרָה׃ מִמְּךָ֥
verses.transliteration: ’ăḏō·nāy ḵāl ta·’ă·wā·ṯî neḡ·də·ḵā wə·’an·ḥā·ṯî lō- nis·tā·rāh mim·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: O Lord my every desire [is] before You my groaning is not hidden from You

verses.original: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר כֹחִ֑י עֲזָבַ֣נִי גַּם־ הֵ֝֗ם וְֽאוֹר־ עֵינַ֥י אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî sə·ḥar·ḥar ḵō·ḥî ‘ă·zā·ḇa·nî gam- hêm wə·’ō·wr- ‘ê·nay ’ên ’it·tî
verses.literal: My heart pounds my strength fails and even . . . the light of my eyes has faded . . .

verses.original: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י׀ וְרֵעַ֗י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י עָמָֽדוּ׃ מֵרָחֹ֥ק
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hă·ḇay wə·rê·‘ay ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū min·ne·ḡeḏ niḡ·‘î ū·qə·rō·w·ḇay ‘ā·mā·ḏū mê·rā·ḥōq
verses.literal: My beloved and friends shun . . . my disease and my kinsmen stand at a distance

verses.original: מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ׀ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת יֶהְגּֽוּ׃ וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šî way·naq·šū wə·ḏō·rə·šê rā·‘ā·ṯî dib·bə·rū haw·wō·wṯ yeh·gū ū·mir·mō·wṯ kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Those who seek my life lay snares those who wish me harm speak destruction plotting deceit all day long

verses.original: כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ וַאֲנִ֣י לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ḵə·ḥê·rêš wa·’ă·nî lō ’eš·mā‘ ū·ḵə·’il·lêm lō yip̄·taḥ- pîw
verses.literal: But like a deaf man I do not hear and like a mute man I do not open my mouth

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת׃ וְאֵ֥ין
verses.transliteration: wā·’ĕ·hî kə·’îš ’ă·šer lō- šō·mê·a‘ bə·p̄îw tō·w·ḵā·ḥō·wṯ wə·’ên
verses.literal: I am like a man who cannot hear whose mouth offers no reply . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי לְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hō·w·ḥā·lə·tî lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’at·tāh ṯa·‘ă·neh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: I wait for You O LORD You will answer O Lord my God

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן־ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִ֑י הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃ עָלַ֥י רַ֝גְלִ֗י בְּמ֥וֹט
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mar·tî pen- yiś·mə·ḥū- lî hiḡ·dî·lū ‘ā·lay raḡ·lî bə·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: For I said Let them not gloat over me those who taunt me when my foot slips

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֲ֭נִי נָכ֑וֹן לְצֶ֣לַע וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י תָמִֽיד׃ נֶגְדִּ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ă·nî nā·ḵō·wn lə·ṣe·la‘ ū·maḵ·’ō·w·ḇî ṯā·mîḏ neḡ·dî
verses.literal: For I am ready to fall and my pain is ever with me

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַגִּ֑יד עֲוֺנִ֥י אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ag·gîḏ ‘ă·wō·nî ’eḏ·’aḡ mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî
verses.literal: Yes I confess my iniquity I am troubled by my sin

verses.original: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·yə·ḇay ḥay·yîm ‘ā·ṣê·mū wə·rab·bū śō·nə·’ay šā·qer
verses.literal: Many are my enemies without cause . . . and many hate me without reason

verses.original: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֣חַת רָ֭עָה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רְדוֹפִי טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·šal·lə·mê ṭō·w·ḇāh ta·ḥaṯ rā·‘āh yiś·ṭə·nū·nî ta·ḥaṯ rə·ḏō·p̄ī ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good

verses.original: אַל־ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אַל־ תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·‘az·ḇê·nî Yah·weh ’al- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî ’ĕ·lō·hay
verses.literal: Do not forsake me O LORD be not far from me O my God

verses.original: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥū·šāh lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî ’ă·ḏō·nāy tə·šū·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Come quickly to help me O Lord my Savior
